scope: Atomic family bootstrap and challenge-read isolation; not a certification of the whole rules file
summary: The new branch derives approval and role from the existing user document, restricts the caller to their own user, allows only familyCircleId to change, and requires a simultaneously created circle with exactly the caller as its sole admin and member and no elevated beta approval. Invalid batches roll back atomically.
validation: Pending account cannot create a family
Approved parent can atomically create and join their own new family
Existing-family reassignment and role escalation remain denied
Additional negative bootstrap cases are tested by scripts/test-redesign-journey.mjs

resolvedFindings.issue: Challenge reads were allowed to all signed-in users.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Reads now require family membership or the trusted administrator claim; emulator tests verify foreign-family reads are denied.
